description: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres provide comprehensive primary health care closer to the community, including maternal and child health, non-communicable diseases, free essential drugs and diagnostic services, and wellness activities.

title: Poshan Abhiyaan / Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Poshan Abhiyaan and the strengthened Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0 aim to improve nutritional outcomes for children, adolescent girls, pregnant women and lactating mothers through Anganwadi services, growth monitoring, supplementary nutrition and behaviour change.
benefits: ["Supplementary nutrition through Anganwadi Centres","Growth monitoring and counselling","Support for pregnant women, lactating mothers and children under 6","Adolescent girl nutrition components","Convergence with health services"]

title: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY) / Free Foodgrains under NFSA
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

short_benefits: Free / Subsidised Foodgrains under NFSA & PMGKAY

title: Stand Up India + Related Women / SC-ST Enterprise Credit Support
ministry: Department of Financial Services / SIDBI
description: Continuing credit facilitation for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs for greenfield enterprises, with handholding support through Stand-Up India portals and convergence with Mudra and other schemes for smaller ticket sizes.
benefits: ["Bank loans Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for greenfield projects","Focus on SC/ST and women entrepreneurs","Handholding for project preparation and bank linkage","Composite term and working capital support"]

title: Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi) - Current
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: PM SVANidhi provides affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume and expand their livelihoods. It offers collateral-free loans in tranches with interest subsidy on timely repayment and incentives for digital transactions.

short_benefits: Up to Rs 50,000 Collateral-Free Loan + 7% Interest Subsidy

title: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) under PMAY-Urban (legacy / residual)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: CLSS component under PMAY-Urban provided interest subsidy on home loans for EWS, LIG and MIG beneficiaries for acquisition or construction of houses. Although the main verticals have evolved, residual and related interest subsidy benefits continue to be relevant for eligible beneficiaries.
benefits: ["Interest subsidy on housing loans for eligible income categories","Reduces EMI burden for first-time home buyers","Support for EWS, LIG and previously MIG segments","Linked to PMAY-Urban goals of Housing for All"]

short_benefits: Interest Subsidy on Home Loans for EWS/LIG

title: National Education Policy linked Scholarships & Samagra Shiksha Support
ministry: Ministry of Education
description: Under Samagra Shiksha and NEP 2020 implementation, various supports are provided for school education including free textbooks, uniforms, transport, inclusive education and vocational education components to ensure equitable and quality education.
benefits: ["Free textbooks and uniforms for eligible students","Support for inclusive education and CWSN","Vocational education exposure at school level","Transport and escort allowances in some cases","Strengthening of schools and teacher training"]
eligibility: ["Students in government and aided schools as per state implementation","Focus on elementary and secondary stages","Who is NOT eligible: Purely private unaided school students for most entitlement components"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","School enrolment proof","Caste / disability certificate if claiming specific benefits"]
short_benefits: Free Textbooks, Uniforms & School Education Support

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: PMKVY is the flagship skill development scheme that provides free short-term skill training and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) to youth, with a focus on employment and entrepreneurship outcomes. Training is aligned to National Skill Qualification Framework.
benefits: ["Free skill training in NSQF aligned courses","Recognition of Prior Learning certification","Monetary reward / certificate on successful assessment","Placement and entrepreneurship support facilitation","Special focus on women, SC/ST and underprivileged youth"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Educational certificates if required for the course","Bank Account details","Passport size photographs"]
short_benefits: Free Skill Training + Certification under PMKVY

title: National Career Service (NCS) / Employment Exchange Modernisation
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: National Career Service portal connects job seekers with employers, provides career counselling, information on skill development and facilitates employment related services. It is the modern avatar of employment exchanges.
benefits: ["Free registration for job seekers and employers","Job matching and career counselling","Information on skill courses and apprenticeships","Model Career Centres support","Transparent employment services"]
eligibility: ["Any Indian job seeker or employer","No income restriction for registration","Who is NOT eligible: None for basic registration"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Educational and experience details for profile","Resume upload optional"]
short_benefits: Free Job Portal + Career Counselling Services

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) - Current
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: PMEGP is a credit-linked subsidy programme for generating self-employment through establishment of micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector. Margin money subsidy is provided on bank loans for new projects.
benefits: ["Margin money subsidy 15-35% of project cost","Higher subsidy for special categories and rural/NE areas","Bank finance for the balance project cost","Project cost ceiling Rs 50 lakh (manufacturing) / Rs 20 lakh (service)","EDP training support"]

short_benefits: 15-35% Margin Money Subsidy + Bank Loan for New Micro Enterprises

title: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) - Tarun Plus & Current Limits
ministry: Ministry of Finance / SIDBI / MUDRA
description: PMMY provides collateral-free loans up to Rs 20 lakh (with Tarun Plus category) to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises under Shishu, Kishore, Tarun and Tarun Plus categories to fund the unfunded.
benefits: ["Collateral-free loans up to Rs 20 lakh","Categories: Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, Tarun Plus","Support for income generating activities","Helps build credit history for small entrepreneurs"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","PAN if available","Business plan / project details","Identity and address proof","Bank Account details"]
short_benefits: Collateral-Free Loan up to Rs 20 Lakh (Mudra)

title: One District One Product (ODOP) related Support under PMFME & State Schemes
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries / State Governments
description: ODOP approach under PMFME and state initiatives identifies one product per district for focused development of processing, branding and marketing. Financial and technical support is provided to micro enterprises in the ODOP product value chain.
benefits: ["Priority under PMFME subsidy for ODOP products","Branding, marketing and common infrastructure support","Capacity building for local products","Value chain development at district level"]

short_benefits: Focused Subsidy & Support for District ODOP Products

title: National AYUSH Mission (NAM)
ministry: Ministry of Ayush
description: National AYUSH Mission promotes AYUSH systems (Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homoeopathy) through support for AYUSH services, educational institutions, quality control of drugs and medicinal plants cultivation.
benefits: ["Support for AYUSH hospitals, dispensaries and educational institutions","Quality control and drug standardisation support","Medicinal plants cultivation and processing assistance","Integration of AYUSH with mainstream healthcare"]
eligibility: ["State AYUSH departments, institutions and eligible organisations as per NAM guidelines","Projects approved under the Mission","Who is NOT eligible: Activities outside the approved components of NAM"]
documents_required: ["Project proposal","Institutional registration","Technical details as required"]
short_benefits: Support for AYUSH Services, Education & Medicinal Plants

title: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) / Anganwadi Services
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: ICDS is one of the world's largest programmes for early childhood care and development. It provides a package of services including supplementary nutrition, immunisation, health check-up, referral, pre-school education and nutrition & health education through Anganwadi Centres.
benefits: ["Supplementary nutrition for children under 6, pregnant and lactating women","Pre-school non-formal education","Immunisation, health check-up and referral services","Nutrition and health education","Anganwadi based delivery close to the community"]
eligibility: ["Children under 6 years, pregnant women and lactating mothers in the Anganwadi area","Open to all eligible beneficiaries in the catchment","Who is NOT eligible: Those outside the target age and physiological groups"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card preferred","MCP Card / Anganwadi registration","Birth related documents for children"]
short_benefits: Supplementary Nutrition + Pre-School + Health Services via Anganwadi

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY) - Ayushman Bharat
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health assurance scheme providing health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families. It offers cashless and paperless access to services at empaneled hospitals.
benefits: ["Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year","Cashless treatment at empaneled public and private hospitals","Covers pre and post hospitalisation expenses","No restriction on family size, age or gender","Over 1900 procedures covered"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Ration Card / SECC verification","PM-JAY e-Card if issued"]
short_benefits: Rs 5 Lakh Health Cover per Family per Year

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) 2.0 / Enhanced
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: PMMVY provides cash maternity benefit to pregnant women and lactating mothers for the first living child to improve health-seeking behaviour and nutrition. Benefits are linked to antenatal check-ups, delivery and vaccination milestones.
benefits: ["Cash incentive of Rs 5,000 in instalments","Promotes antenatal care, institutional delivery and immunisation","Direct Benefit Transfer to the woman's account","Supports maternal and child nutrition"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card of the woman","MCP Card / pregnancy records","Bank Account details of the woman"]
short_benefits: Rs 5,000 Maternity Cash Benefit for First Child

title: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao is a national initiative to address declining Child Sex Ratio and related issues of empowerment of girls through multi-sectoral interventions in education, health and advocacy for the girl child.
benefits: ["Awareness and advocacy for value of girl child","Support for education and enrolment of girls","Convergence with health and nutrition schemes","District-level action plans in focused districts"]
eligibility: ["Girl children and families in implementing districts and nationwide advocacy","Open awareness programme with focused interventions","Who is NOT eligible: Not a direct individual cash scheme; benefits are through programmes"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar for related education/health linkages","School enrolment documents for education components"]
short_benefits: National Mission for Girl Child Survival, Protection & Education
application_url: https://wcd.nic.in/ or BBBP related state portals

title: National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) / Namami Gange
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
description: Namami Gange is an integrated conservation mission to accomplish effective abatement of pollution, conservation and rejuvenation of the National River Ganga. It includes sewage treatment, river front development, biodiversity and afforestation components.
benefits: ["Sewage treatment infrastructure along Ganga basin","River surface cleaning and biodiversity conservation","Public awareness and Ganga gram components","Improved water quality and river health"]

documents_required: ["Project proposals from state agencies","Technical and environmental clearances"]
short_benefits: Ganga Rejuvenation - Sewage Treatment & River Conservation

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / Ministry of Jal Shakti
description: PMKSY aims to enhance physical access of water on farm, expand cultivable area under assured irrigation, improve on-farm water use efficiency and introduce sustainable water conservation practices. It includes components like Accelerated Irrigation Benefits, Har Khet Ko Pani and Per Drop More Crop.
benefits: ["Subsidy and support for micro-irrigation (drip and sprinkler)","Accelerated completion of irrigation projects","Watershed development and water harvesting","Improved water use efficiency at farm level"]

short_benefits: Micro-Irrigation Subsidy + Irrigation Infrastructure Support

title: Soil Health Card Scheme / Soil Health Management
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Soil Health Card Scheme provides farmers with information on the nutrient status of their soil along with recommendations on the appropriate dosage of nutrients for improving soil health and fertility. It promotes balanced use of fertilisers.
benefits: ["Soil Health Card with nutrient status and crop-wise recommendations","Promotes balanced fertiliser use and reduced cost of cultivation","Periodic soil testing cycle","Improved soil fertility and productivity"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Land details / khasra","Contact details for card delivery"]

title: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: NFSM aims to increase production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals and nutri-cereals through area expansion and productivity enhancement in a sustainable manner, restoring soil fertility and creating employment opportunities.
benefits: ["Subsidy on seeds, farm machinery and other inputs for target crops","Support for demonstrations and cropping system based approaches","Focus on pulses and nutri-cereals for nutritional security","Capacity building of farmers"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Land records","Bank Account details","Crop details"]
short_benefits: Input Subsidy & Support for Rice, Wheat, Pulses & Nutri-Cereals

title: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY / RKVY-RAFTAAR)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: RKVY is a state-plan scheme that incentivises states to increase public investment in agriculture and allied sectors. RKVY-RAFTAAR focuses on making farming a remunerative economic activity through strengthening farmer efforts, risk mitigation and promoting agri-business entrepreneurship.
benefits: ["Flexible funding to states for agriculture and allied sector projects","Support for infrastructure, production growth and agri-entrepreneurship","Sub-schemes for value chain and innovation","State-specific prioritisation"]

documents_required: ["Project proposals from states","As per specific sub-scheme requirements for individual beneficiaries"]
short_benefits: State-Flexible Funding for Agriculture & Agri-Entrepreneurship

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) - Current
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: SMAM promotes agricultural mechanisation among small and marginal farmers through financial assistance for purchase of machinery, establishment of Custom Hiring Centres and Farm Machinery Banks, and training.
benefits: ["Subsidy on purchase of tractors, power tillers and other farm equipment","Higher subsidy rates for SC/ST, small & marginal farmers and women","Support for Custom Hiring Centres","Training and demonstration of equipment"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Land records","Bank Account details","Quotation from supplier","Caste certificate if claiming higher rate"]
short_benefits: Subsidy on Farm Machinery & Custom Hiring Centres

title: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) - Current
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
description: PMFME provides financial, technical and business support for upgradation of existing micro food processing enterprises. Credit-linked subsidy of 35% (max Rs 10 lakh) is a major component along with branding, marketing and capacity building under ODOP approach.
benefits: ["35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to Rs 10 lakh","Support for FPOs, SHGs and cooperatives","Branding and marketing assistance","Capacity building and common infrastructure"]

short_benefits: 35% Subsidy up to Rs 10 Lakh for Micro Food Processing

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
description: Atal Pension Yojana is a government-backed pension scheme for workers in the unorganised sector. Subscribers receive a fixed minimum pension between Rs 1,000 and Rs 5,000 per month after the age of 60, depending on their contribution amount and age of joining, with the government co-contributing in eligible cases for a limited period.

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Savings bank account details","Mobile number","Age proof"]

application_url: https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in/ or any bank / post office

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: PMJJBY is an affordable life insurance scheme offering Rs 2 lakh life cover for death due to any reason at a very low annual premium. It is available to savings bank account holders in the age group 18-50 years and is renewable yearly.
benefits: ["Life insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh for death due to any reason","Very low annual premium (around Rs 436 as per latest rates)","Auto-debit from linked bank account","Easy enrolment through bank or post office"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Savings bank account details","Consent form for auto-debit"]
short_benefits: Rs 2 Lakh Life Insurance at Very Low Premium

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: PMSBY is an accident insurance scheme providing Rs 2 lakh cover for accidental death and full disability and Rs 1 lakh for partial disability at an extremely low annual premium of Rs 20. It is linked to savings bank accounts.
benefits: ["Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or full permanent disability","Rs 1 lakh for partial permanent disability","Annual premium of only Rs 20","Auto-debit facility from bank account"]
eligibility: ["Savings bank account holder aged 18 to 70 years","Must give consent for auto-debit","Who is NOT eligible: Persons above 70 years at the time of renewal"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Savings bank account details","Consent for auto-debit"]
short_benefits: Rs 2 Lakh Accident Insurance at Rs 20/year

title: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Economic Affairs
description: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate is a short-term small savings scheme for women and girls offering attractive interest rate and flexibility of partial withdrawal. It was introduced as a one-time or time-bound scheme to encourage savings among women.
benefits: ["Attractive fixed interest rate for the tenure","Partial withdrawal facility after a lock-in period","Account can be opened in the name of a woman or a girl child","Available at post offices and authorised banks"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Identity and address proof","Age proof for minor","Passport size photograph"]

title: National Savings Certificate (NSC)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / India Post
description: National Savings Certificate is a fixed-income, government-backed savings instrument available at post offices. It offers fixed interest rate, tax benefit under Section 80C and is suitable for small and medium savers seeking safety.

title: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme (SCSS)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / India Post
description: Senior Citizens Savings Scheme is a government-backed savings scheme for individuals aged 60 years and above (and certain early retirees). It offers higher interest rate and quarterly interest payout, making it suitable for regular income needs of senior citizens.

title: Kisan Vikas Patra (KVP) - Current
ministry: Ministry of Finance / India Post
description: Kisan Vikas Patra is a small savings instrument that doubles the invested amount in a predetermined period at the prevailing interest rate. It is available at post offices and authorised banks and is popular among small savers seeking guaranteed doubling.
benefits: ["Amount doubles in a fixed period (as per current rate)","Government-backed safety","Can be transferred and pledged as security","Available in multiple denominations","No upper investment limit in most cases"]
eligibility: ["Any adult individual (single or joint)","Trusts as per rules","Who is NOT eligible: NRIs for new investments in standard form"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","PAN Card","Identity and address proof","Photograph"]
short_benefits: Doubling of Investment in Fixed Period (Government Backed)

title: National Pension System (NPS) - All Citizen Model
ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
description: National Pension System is a voluntary, long-term retirement savings scheme open to all Indian citizens. It offers market-linked returns with a mix of equity, corporate bonds and government securities, and provides tax benefits under Section 80C and 80CCD.

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","PAN Card","Bank Account details","Photograph and signature/thumb impression"]
short_benefits: Voluntary Market-Linked Retirement Savings with Tax Benefits

title: Sovereign Gold Bond Scheme (SGB) - Current Tranches
ministry: Ministry of Finance / RBI
description: Sovereign Gold Bonds are government securities denominated in grams of gold. They offer an alternative to physical gold with interest payout, capital gains treatment benefits on redemption, and elimination of storage and purity risks.

short_benefits: Government Gold Bonds with 2.5% Interest + Gold Price Linked Returns
application_url: https://www.rbi.org.in/ or through banks / Stock Holding / Post Office

title: eShram Portal / Registration for Unorganised Workers
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: eShram is the national database of unorganised workers. Registration on eShram provides a Universal Account Number (UAN) and enables access to social security schemes, accident insurance and future benefits targeted at unorganised sector workers.

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
description: PM-SYM is a voluntary and contributory pension scheme for unorganised workers. Subscribers receive a minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after attaining the age of 60 years, with matching contribution from the government.

title: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) - Detailed Components
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: NSAP comprises Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS), Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS), Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS), National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS) and Annapurna. It provides social assistance to BPL households.

short_benefits: Monthly Pensions for Elderly, Widows & Disabled (BPL)

title: Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise (SMILE)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: SMILE is a comprehensive scheme for the welfare of transgender persons and persons engaged in begging. It provides rehabilitation, medical facilities, counselling, education, skill development and livelihood opportunities.

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Transgender identity certificate / relevant proof","Bank Account details","Photographs"]
short_benefits: Rehabilitation, Skill & Livelihood Support for Transgender & Beggars

title: Scheme for Adolescent Girls (SAG) / Poshan related Adolescent Support
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Scheme for Adolescent Girls aims to improve the nutritional and health status of out-of-school adolescent girls, promote awareness and provide life skills and vocational training support through Anganwadi centres and convergence.
benefits: ["Supplementary nutrition for adolescent girls","Health check-up and referral services","Nutrition and health education","Life skills and vocational guidance in some components"]
eligibility: ["Out-of-school adolescent girls in the target age group (mainly 11-14 or as notified)","Registered at Anganwadi centres","Who is NOT eligible: School-going girls already covered under other mid-day or school programmes in some cases"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Age proof","Anganwadi registration"]
short_benefits: Nutrition & Life Skills Support for Adolescent Girls

title: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: PM-AASHA is an umbrella scheme to ensure remunerative prices to farmers for their produce. It includes Price Support Scheme (PSS), Price Deficiency Payment Scheme (PDPS) and pilot Private Procurement & Stockist Scheme (PPSS) for notified pulses, oilseeds and copra.

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Land records / cultivation proof","Bank Account details","Crop details"]
short_benefits: MSP Assurance & Price Deficiency Payment for Farmers
application_url: https://www.agricoop.gov.in/ or state agriculture marketing portals

title: Market Intervention Scheme (MIS) and Price Support Scheme (PSS)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: MIS and PSS are implemented to protect farmers from distress sales when prices fall below a certain threshold for perishable and non-perishable commodities. Procurement or price difference support is provided through designated agencies.
benefits: ["Procurement support at notified prices","Prevention of distress sale","Stabilisation of market prices for farmers","Implemented through NAFED, SFAC and state agencies"]
eligibility: ["Farmers of the notified commodity in the implementing state/district","As per specific MIS/PSS notification","Who is NOT eligible: Non-farmers and commodities not under the notification"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Land / cultivation proof","Bank Account details","Identity proof"]
short_benefits: Price Support & Market Intervention for Farmers

title: Interest Subvention Scheme for Farmers (ISS) - Short Term Crop Loans
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / Ministry of Finance
description: The Interest Subvention Scheme provides interest relief to farmers on short-term crop loans up to Rs 3 lakh. Farmers receive loans at subvented rates (effective low interest) and prompt repayment incentive further reduces the effective rate.
benefits: ["Interest subvention making short-term crop loans available at low effective rates","Additional incentive for prompt repayment","Support for crop production credit needs","Available through banks and cooperative institutions"]
eligibility: ["Farmers taking short-term crop loans up to Rs 3 lakh","Loan from scheduled banks, RRBs or cooperatives","Who is NOT eligible: Loans above the ceiling for full subvention benefit and non-crop loans"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Land records / cultivation certificate","Loan application through bank","KYC documents"]
short_benefits: Low Interest Short-Term Crop Loans (with Subvention)

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / Ministry of Finance
description: Kisan Credit Card provides farmers with timely and adequate credit for crop production, post-harvest expenses, working capital for animal husbandry and fisheries, and some consumption needs. It is operated through a revolving cash credit facility.
benefits: ["Revolving credit for crop and allied activities","Flexible withdrawal and repayment","Interest subvention benefits available on eligible limits","Insurance coverage options under crop insurance convergence","Simplified documentation and renewal"]
eligibility: ["Farmers (individual or joint), tenant farmers, sharecroppers, SHGs and JLGs of farmers","Allied activities (dairy, fisheries, poultry) also covered under expanded KCC","Who is NOT eligible: Non-agricultural purposes outside the scheme guidelines"]

short_benefits: Revolving Crop & Allied Credit through Kisan Credit Card
application_url: Through any bank branch or https://www.nabard.org/

title: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: The Central Sector Scheme for Formation and Promotion of 10,000 FPOs aims to collectivise farmers, especially small and marginal farmers, into producer organisations so that they can benefit from economies of scale in input purchase, processing and marketing.
benefits: ["Financial support for FPO formation and handholding","Equity grant and credit guarantee support","Training and capacity building of FPO members and boards","Better market access and bargaining power for farmers","Professional management support for a limited period"]
eligibility: ["Groups of farmers (especially small and marginal) willing to form FPOs","Implemented through Cluster Based Business Organizations and Implementing Agencies","Who is NOT eligible: Already mature large FPOs not needing formation support"]
documents_required: ["Farmer identity and land details","Group resolution / application through Implementing Agency","Bank Account of the proposed FPO"]
short_benefits: Support for Formation & Strengthening of Farmer Producer Organizations

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) - Full Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: PMMSY is a flagship scheme for sustainable and responsible development of the fisheries sector. It covers marine and inland fisheries, aquaculture, infrastructure, post-harvest management, traceability and welfare of fishers with both central and state shares.
benefits: ["Capital and input subsidies for aquaculture, fishing vessels, hatcheries and cold chain","Support for infrastructure and post-harvest facilities","Livelihood and welfare components for fishers","Traceability and quality assurance support","Enhanced production and income opportunities"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Fisher identity / registration if applicable","Project proposal","Bank Account details","Land or water body documents"]
short_benefits: Comprehensive Subsidy & Support for Fisheries and Aquaculture

title: Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying / NABARD
description: FIDF provides concessional finance for development of fisheries infrastructure including fishing harbours, fish landing centres, cold chain, ice plants, hatcheries and aquaculture infrastructure to create robust post-harvest and production facilities.
benefits: ["Concessional financing / interest subvention for fisheries infrastructure","Support for harbours, cold chain, processing and aquaculture facilities","Longer repayment periods","Encourages private and cooperative investment in fisheries value chain"]
eligibility: ["State governments, cooperatives, private entrepreneurs, FPOs and other eligible entities","Projects meeting FIDF guidelines for infrastructure creation","Who is NOT eligible: Pure working capital without infrastructure component"]
documents_required: ["Detailed Project Report","Entity registration documents","Land and technical clearances","Bank / NABARD related documentation"]
short_benefits: Concessional Finance for Fisheries Infrastructure

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: PM-KMY is a voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers. Farmers contribute a small monthly amount and receive a minimum pension of Rs 3,000 per month after the age of 60, with matching contribution from the government.
benefits: ["Minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after 60 years","Matching contribution by the Central Government","Family pension to spouse on death of the subscriber","Low and age-based contribution structure","Simple enrolment through CSCs"]
eligibility: ["Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 years","Cultivable land up to 2 hectares","Not covered under other statutory pension schemes in many cases","Who is NOT eligible: Large farmers and those already in organised sector pension schemes"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Land records proving small/marginal status","Savings bank account","Mobile number"]
short_benefits: Assured Pension Rs 3,000/month for Small & Marginal Farmers

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund provides medium to long-term financing facility for investment in viable projects of post-harvest management infrastructure and community farming assets. It offers 3% interest subvention and credit guarantee support.

eligibility: ["Farmers, FPOs, PACS, cooperatives, SHGs, startups, state agencies and agri-entrepreneurs","Project must create post-harvest or community farming infrastructure","Who is NOT eligible: Pure working capital loans without infrastructure creation"]
documents_required: ["Project report","Entity / farmer documents","Land documents","Bank Account and KYC"]
short_benefits: 3% Interest Subvention + Credit Guarantee for Agri Infrastructure

title: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM) - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: NBHM promotes scientific beekeeping, honey production, quality testing, processing and marketing under the goal of Sweet Revolution. It supports infrastructure, capacity building, women participation and market linkages through Mini Missions.
benefits: ["Assistance for bee colonies, hives and equipment","Support for honey testing labs and processing units","Training and capacity building","Promotion of FPOs and women beekeepers","Market development and branding support"]

documents_required: ["Aadhaar / entity documents","Project proposal","Bank Account details"]
short_benefits: Subsidy & Infrastructure Support for Beekeeping and Honey

title: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: MIDH is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme for the holistic growth of the horticulture sector covering fruits, vegetables, root and tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, flowers, aromatic plants, coconut, cashew, cocoa and bamboo. It supports production, post-harvest and marketing.

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Land records","Bank Account details","Project / quotation documents"]
short_benefits: Holistic Support for Horticulture Production & Post-Harvest

title: National Livestock Mission (NLM) - Full
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: National Livestock Mission supports entrepreneurship development, breed improvement, feed and fodder development and risk management in the livestock sector. Capital subsidy is provided for various livestock-related entrepreneurial activities.

documents_required: ["Aadhaar / entity documents","Project report","Bank Account details","Land or unit proof"]
short_benefits: Capital Subsidy for Livestock Entrepreneurship & Breed Improvement

title: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF) - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying

documents_required: ["Project report","Entity registration","Land and technical documents","Bank KYC"]
short_benefits: Interest Subvention for Dairy, Meat & Feed Infrastructure

title: Dairy Infrastructure Development Fund (DIDF) / Dairy Processing Support
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying / NABARD
description: DIDF and related dairy credit schemes provide interest subvention and financing support for setting up and modernising milk processing plants, chilling infrastructure and value-added dairy product facilities.

documents_required: ["Project report","Entity registration documents","Land and technical clearances","Bank documents"]
short_benefits: Interest Subvention for Dairy Processing & Chilling Infrastructure

title: National Programme for Dairy Development (NPDD)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: NPDD aims to enhance quality of milk and milk products and increase share of organised milk procurement through strengthening of dairy cooperatives and producer institutions, quality testing and cold chain infrastructure.

eligibility: ["Dairy cooperatives, producer companies, state federations and implementing agencies","Projects approved under NPDD guidelines","Who is NOT eligible: Activities outside the quality and cooperative strengthening mandate"]
documents_required: ["Project proposal","Institutional documents","Technical details"]
short_benefits: Support for Dairy Cooperatives, Quality Testing & Cold Chain

title: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana aims to provide all-weather road connectivity to eligible unconnected rural habitations. It focuses on new connectivity and upgradation of existing rural roads to improve access to markets, health and education facilities.

short_benefits: All-Weather Rural Road Connectivity

title: Shyama Prasad Mukherji Rurban Mission (SPMRM)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Rurban Mission aims to develop rural clusters with urban amenities while preserving the rural essence. It focuses on integrated development of selected clusters through infrastructure, economic activities and social services.

title: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U) 2.0 / Current
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

Under various verticals including Beneficiary Led Construction, Affordable Housing in Partnership and other components, financial assistance is provided for construction or purchase of houses, with focus on EWS and LIG.

title: Affordable Rental Housing Complexes (ARHC) under PMAY-U
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

title: Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban (SBM-U) 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: SBM-Urban 2.0 focuses on sustainable sanitation, used water management, solid waste management and making cities garbage-free. It provides financial and technical support to Urban Local Bodies for toilets, waste processing and behavioural change.

title: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation 2.0 (AMRUT 2.0)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: AMRUT 2.0 aims to make cities water secure by providing universal water supply through functional taps to all households and managing used water. It also supports city water balance plans, rejuvenation of water bodies and development of green spaces.

title: National Urban Health Mission (NUHM)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: NUHM is a sub-mission under the National Health Mission that addresses health needs of the urban population, particularly the urban poor, through strengthening of urban primary health infrastructure, outreach and referral services.
benefits: ["Urban Primary Health Centres and outreach services","Focus on urban poor and vulnerable populations","Maternal, child and communicable disease services in urban areas","Referral linkages with higher facilities","Community health workers in urban settings"]

title: National Digital Health Mission / Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) - Current

ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade / SIDBI

title: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Schemes - Various Sectors

title: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS) - Detailed

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Finance

short_benefits: Rs 2 Lakh Life Insurance at Very Low Premium

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: PMSBY is an accident insurance scheme providing Rs 2 lakh cover for accidental death and full disability and Rs 1 lakh for partial disability at an extremely low annual premium of Rs 20. It is linked to savings bank accounts.

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card","Savings bank account details","Consent for auto-debit"]
short_benefits: Rs 2 Lakh Accident Insurance at Rs 20/year

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) - Full Details
ministry: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
description: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana is the national mission for financial inclusion. It provides universal access to banking facilities with zero-balance savings accounts, RuPay debit cards, accidental insurance cover, overdraft facility and direct benefit transfer readiness for every household.
benefits: ["Zero-balance savings bank account","RuPay debit card with inbuilt accident insurance of Rs 2 lakh","Overdraft facility up to Rs 10,000 after satisfactory operation","Access to Direct Benefit Transfer of government schemes","Life cover of Rs 30,000 in eligible cases"]

short_benefits: Zero Balance Account + RuPay Card + Insurance + Overdraft

title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority
description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest publicly funded health assurance scheme providing a cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to over 12 crore eligible poor and vulnerable families. It is cashless and paperless at empaneled hospitals.
benefits: ["Health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year","Cashless treatment at empaneled public and private hospitals","Covers secondary and tertiary hospitalisation expenses","Pre and post hospitalisation benefits as per package","No restriction on family size or age"]

short_benefits: Rs 5 Lakh Health Cover per Family for Hospitalisation

title: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres (AB-HWC) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres aim to provide comprehensive primary healthcare including maternal and child health, non-communicable diseases, free essential drugs and diagnostics closer to the community. They form the foundation of the primary healthcare system under Ayushman Bharat.

title: National Health Mission (NHM) - Full Components
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: National Health Mission (including NRHM and NUHM) aims to provide accessible, affordable and quality healthcare to the rural and urban population, with special focus on the poor and vulnerable. It supports reproductive, maternal, newborn, child and adolescent health, communicable and non-communicable disease control and health system strengthening.
benefits: ["Strengthening of public health facilities","Free drugs and diagnostics initiatives","ASHA and community health worker support","Maternal and child health programmes","Disease control programmes"]

title: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Janani Suraksha Yojana is a safe motherhood intervention under NHM that promotes institutional delivery among poor pregnant women by providing cash assistance. It integrates cash assistance with delivery and post-delivery care.
benefits: ["Cash assistance for institutional delivery","Higher assistance in low performing states and for rural areas","Support for BPL and SC/ST women in many states","Encourages institutional deliveries and reduces maternal mortality"]

title: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: JSSK provides completely free and cashless services to pregnant women for normal deliveries and caesarean operations and to sick newborns up to 1 year of age in public health institutions. It includes free drugs, diagnostics, diet, transport and blood.
benefits: ["Free delivery (normal and C-section) in public facilities","Free drugs, diagnostics, diet and blood","Free transport from home to facility and drop back","Free treatment for sick infants up to 1 year","No user charges in public health institutions"]

title: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: PMSMA provides fixed-day free antenatal care to pregnant women on the 9th of every month in public health facilities. It focuses on identifying high-risk pregnancies and ensuring quality antenatal check-ups by doctors and specialists.
benefits: ["Free antenatal check-up by doctor / specialist on 9th of every month","Identification and management of high-risk pregnancies","Lab investigations and ultrasound as per protocol","Counselling and birth preparedness"]

application_url: Through public health facilities or https://pmsma.mohfw.gov.in/

title: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: RBSK is a child health screening and early intervention programme under NHM that screens children from birth to 18 years for 4Ds – Defects at birth, Diseases, Deficiencies and Developmental delays including disabilities. Free treatment and management is provided for identified conditions.
benefits: ["Screening of children 0-18 years for birth defects, diseases, deficiencies and developmental delays","Free treatment and surgeries for identified conditions","Early intervention services","Referral and follow-up support"]
eligibility: ["All children from birth to 18 years in the community and schools","Who is NOT eligible: None for screening services"]
documents_required: ["Aadhaar preferred","School or Anganwadi identity if applicable"]
short_benefits: Free Screening & Treatment for Children 0-18 Years (4Ds)

title: Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP) / Mission Indradhanush - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: The Universal Immunisation Programme provides free vaccines against preventable diseases to children and pregnant women. Mission Indradhanush and Intensified Mission Indradhanush focus on increasing full immunisation coverage by targeting left-out and drop-out children.
benefits: ["Free vaccines against tuberculosis, polio, diphtheria, pertussis, tetanus, measles, hepatitis B, Hib, rotavirus, pneumococcal and other diseases as per schedule","Special drives under Mission Indradhanush for left-out children","Improved child survival and reduced disease burden"]
eligibility: ["All children as per national immunisation schedule","Pregnant women for TT / Td vaccines","Who is NOT eligible: None for age-appropriate free vaccines"]
documents_required: ["MCP Card / immunisation card","Aadhaar preferred"]
short_benefits: Free Vaccines for Children & Pregnant Women under UIP
application_url: Through ANM / ASHA / Health facilities or https://nhm.gov.in/

title: National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) / Nikshay - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: NTEP aims to eliminate tuberculosis in India. It provides free diagnosis, free treatment including newer drugs for drug-resistant TB, nutritional support (Nikshay Poshan Yojana) and digital monitoring through Nikshay portal.

documents_required: ["Aadhaar Card preferred","Bank Account for nutritional support","Diagnosis and treatment records"]
short_benefits: Free TB Treatment + Rs 500/month Nutritional Support
application_url: https://nikshay.in/ or through TB units / health facilities

title: National Viral Hepatitis Control Programme (NVHCP) - Full Details
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: NVHCP provides free diagnosis and treatment for viral hepatitis, especially Hepatitis B and C, through designated treatment centres. It aims to reduce morbidity and mortality due to viral hepatitis and prevent transmission.

application_url: Through designated treatment centres or https://nvhcp.mohfw.gov.in/

title: Mission Shakti (Umbrella Scheme for Women Safety & Empowerment) - Comprehensive
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Mission Shakti is the umbrella scheme for the safety, security and empowerment of women. It has two sub-schemes: Sambal (safety and security) covering One Stop Centres, Women Helpline, Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and Nari Adalat; and Samarthya (empowerment) covering Ujjawala, Swadhar Greh, Working Women Hostel, National Creche Scheme and Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana with modifications. It follows a life-cycle continuum approach for women-led development.

title: Mission Vatsalya (Child Protection Services) - Comprehensive
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Mission Vatsalya (erstwhile Child Protection Services / ICPS) is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme to ensure care, protection, development and well-being of children in difficult circumstances. It promotes family-based non-institutional care as the preferred option and institutional care as last resort, covering Children in Need of Care and Protection and Children in Conflict with Law.
benefits: ["Sponsorship, foster care, adoption and aftercare support","Institutional care through Child Care Institutions when needed","Emergency outreach via Childline (1098)","Counselling, rehabilitation and reintegration services","Support for children in need of care and protection and in conflict with law"]

title: Tele-MANAS (National Tele Mental Health Programme) - Comprehensive
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Tele-MANAS is the digital arm of the National Mental Health Programme providing 24x7 free tele-mental health counselling, psychotherapy, psychiatric consultations, video consultations and e-prescriptions. It operates through Tele-MANAS cells across States/UTs and a toll-free number (14416), available in multiple Indian languages, along with a dedicated mobile app.
benefits: ["24x7 free tele-counselling and mental health support","Video consultation and e-prescription facility","Services in multiple Indian languages","Mobile app for self-help and connection to helpline","Referral to higher mental health care when needed"]

title: BharatNet / Amended BharatNet Programme - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Communications / Department of Telecommunications
description: BharatNet (formerly National Optical Fibre Network) aims to provide broadband connectivity to all Gram Panchayats in India. The Amended BharatNet Programme focuses on upgrading existing network, last-mile connectivity on demand, and making rural broadband accessible through service-ready infrastructure and partnerships with states and implementing agencies.

title: National Creche Scheme (Palna) under Mission Shakti - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: The National Creche Scheme (now under Palna component of Mission Shakti Samarthya) provides day-care facilities for children of working mothers, including nutrition, health check-ups and early childhood education support, to enable women to participate in the workforce.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) under Mission Shakti - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

It is implemented as a component of Mission Shakti Samarthya through Direct Benefit Transfer.
benefits: ["Cash incentive of Rs 5,000 in instalments for first child","Enhanced support for second child if girl (as per current guidelines)","Direct Benefit Transfer to Aadhaar-seeded bank/post office account","Encourages antenatal care, institutional delivery and immunisation","Wage loss compensation for working women"]

title: Childline 1098 / Emergency Outreach under Mission Vatsalya - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Childline 1098 is the 24-hour emergency outreach service for children in need of care and protection. It is integrated under Mission Vatsalya and provides immediate assistance, rescue, counselling and linkage to Child Welfare Committees and other protection services.
benefits: ["24x7 emergency helpline for children in distress","Rescue and immediate protection support","Counselling and referral to CWC / District Child Protection Unit","Support for missing, abandoned, abused or trafficked children","Nationwide coverage"]

title: District Mental Health Programme (DMHP) under NMHP - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: The District Mental Health Programme is the key implementation arm of the National Mental Health Programme. It provides outpatient services, counselling, drugs, outreach and support for persons with mental illness at district, CHC and PHC levels, and is strengthened by Tele-MANAS as its digital arm.
benefits: ["Outpatient mental health services at district hospitals and below","Counselling and psycho-social interventions","Supply of essential psychiatric drugs","Outreach and community support","Integration with Tele-MANAS for expanded reach"]
eligibility: ["Persons with mental illness or seeking mental health care","Covered under National Health Mission support in districts","Who is NOT eligible: None for basic services"]
documents_required: ["As required at health facility (Aadhaar preferred)"]

title: Nari Adalat under Mission Shakti - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Nari Adalat is a new component under the Sambal sub-scheme of Mission Shakti. It is a women collective / alternative dispute resolution mechanism at the gram panchayat level to provide accessible, gender-sensitive resolution of disputes affecting women, complementing formal legal systems.

title: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 - Comprehensive Umbrella
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development

It strengthens Anganwadi services, provides supplementary nutrition, focuses on the first 1000 days, adolescent girls nutrition, and convergence for reducing malnutrition, stunting and anaemia.

title: Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETI) - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / Banks

short_benefits: Free Skill Training + Credit Linkage for Rural Self-Employment

title: PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman) / Mid-Day Meal Scheme - Comprehensive
ministry: Ministry of Education

title: e-Shram Portal / National Database of Unorganised Workers - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment

title: PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry / DPIIT

title: Bharatmala Pariyojana - Detailed
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
description: Bharatmala Pariyojana is a flagship highway development programme aimed at optimising the efficiency of freight and passenger movement across the country by developing economic corridors, inter-corridors, feeder routes, national corridors efficiency improvement, border and international connectivity roads, coastal and port connectivity roads and expressways.
benefits: ["Development of economic corridors and expressways","Improved freight and passenger movement efficiency","Better connectivity to ports, borders and industrial clusters","Reduced logistics cost and travel time","Boost to economic activity along corridors"]

documents_required: ["N/A for individual citizens"]

title: Sagarmala Programme - Detailed

ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
